argv:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/bridge-comand-bootstrap"
if [ ! -d "$ROOT/.git" ]; then git clone https://github.com/One-Wave-Universe/Bridge-Comand.git "$ROOT"; fi
git -C "$ROOT" fetch --prune origin main
git -C "$ROOT" checkout --detach origin/main
bash "$ROOT/hive-pipe/install_desktop_commander_remote.sh"
systemctl --user is-active desktop-commander-remote.service
printf 'DESKTOP_COMMANDER_REPAIR_OK\n'
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD
intention: Restore the existing Desktop Commander Remote Device from current Bridge-Comand main and reuse its saved authorization.
consequence: Creates or repairs only the user-level desktop-commander-remote.service, starts it, and prints service and bridge commit receipts; does not reset Desktop Commander authorization.
